column1: # Tenancy conformance matrix. One row per check, run by e2e/conformance.sh as
# the named identity with plain kubectl or curl. The job fails if any observed
# result differs from the expected one.
# identity  a-admin / a-dev / a-viewer / b-admin / b-dev / b-viewer: per-run
# method    kubectl  target is the kubectl argument list
#           api      target is "<VERB> <path>", sent with curl and the identity's
#                    client certificate straight to the API server
#           http     target is "<ns>/<deployment> <url>": curl runs inside that
# expect    allowed, or denied:<layer> where layer is the component that must
#           reject it: rbac, policy (Kyverno), pss (Pod Security admission),
# check     for allowed rows: "<ns>|<object>|<jsonpath>|<expected value>" read
#           back as platform after the action, or "-"
